dashboard.task: Mutation-lifecycle surface (Blueprint §4 flow 3 'progress/result surfaced in dashboard') inside src/ui/** + src/extensions/dashboard/** + tests/ui/**: (a) extend services/bridge.js with typed client methods matching the accepted platform DTOs: getMutationStatus(planId) (GET) and recover(scope) (POST) — same typed BridgeError taxonomy, 404=>null semantics, BAD_RESPONSE wrapping; (b) wire the apply flow: after requestApply(ops, confirmedHash) the page polls getMutationStatus until a terminal state (APPLY_COMPLETED / ROLLED_BACK / RECOVERED / failed-terminal) with a bounded poll count and renders the terminal outcome in the existing role="status" region (applied / rolled back / failed with guidance); polling stops permanently on terminal state or bridge error (prove no infinite loop, no polling after terminal); (c) explicit user-initiated recover affordance for crash-mid-apply states (T-RB1 UX counterpart): a visible control that calls bridge.recover(scope) only on explicit click, rendering the RecoverySummary outcome; never auto-retries or auto-applies anything destructive without user intent (Contract §9.2); (d) prepare the F-N1 repoint seam: extend validation/mirror.js setValidationSource contract documentation and shape so a server-side ValidationResult-shaped source (the PUT /ruleset domain-side validation response) can be injected verbatim, keeping the provisional local validators as the offline fallback and current behavior unchanged when unconfigured; (e) address audit N-3 cosmetically only if trivial (document the _adoptFocus coupling in diffPreviewModal header); do not touch kit internals.

billing.task: Plan-state projection and reconciliation machine (Contract §7 lifecycle; Blueprint §4 flow 5) inside src/billing/** + tests/billing/**, pure and Wix-import-free: (a) a deterministic projection module that ingests app-billing webhook EVENTS (Paid Plan Purchased, Paid Plan Auto Renewal Cancelled, App Installation Created/Updated — envelope semantics only, transport stays in the platform pipeline) plus periodic Get App Instance SNAPSHOTS and outputs the current EntitlementSignal; (b) reconciliation supremacy: a snapshot always overrides event-derived state (trial→paid conversion fires NO event — Contract §7 — so periodic reconciliation is mandatory, not optional); out-of-order, duplicated, and replayed events converge idempotently to the same projected state; (c) lifecycle branches tested both ways: cancelled-until-expiry keeps paid identifiers; dunning window (expired date but isFree:false) stays PAID; auto-renewal cancellation downgrades only at period end given a confirming snapshot; clone markers never leak across instances; UNKNOWN_PLAN_IDENTIFIER persists per accepted semantics; (d) fold accepted-audit observation 1: when the billing snapshot path is healthy but listing is still failing, clear('BILLING_API_FAILURE') must not be skipped — restructure the early-return so warning liveness is per-source (or document with a test why single-source clearing is correct); observation 2: make FAIL_OPEN_RESOLUTION carry an explicit null tier instead of the misleading 'TIER_11_PLUS' placeholder unless a consumer proves otherwise; (e) expose the projection as the snapshot source for createEntitlementGate via a narrow port so INT-C3-1's enforcement path can consume reconciled state without importing webhook types.
billing.why_needed: Contract §7 makes periodic reconciliation mandatory because trial→paid conversion fires no webhook; the accepted entitlement resolver is snapshot-pull only and has no event-ingestion/reconciliation model, leaving Blueprint flow 5 unimplemented.
